teaser: We teach programming the way Lockhart says we teach maths: concepts first. Explorer coding starts where the hook is.
core_idea: Programming, like maths in Lockhart's lament, is usually taught upside down, concepts before purpose, so people dislike it and return to Excel; what hooks a programmer is control in a short feedback loop, which the good tools always had, and explorer coding by voice now starts at that end, with coding understood as communication whose primitives people will read more, not less.

quotes.text: The thing about programming is the ability to control something: to make something work.
They program wherever the loop is short and the result is theirs.
Coding is communication: speaking to a computer, through an abstraction layer.
